request.operation: independent adversarial review of bounded external Compose service adoption
request.evaluated_model: not applicable; deterministic service-runtime code was reviewed
request.scope: service-runtime Docker identity, manifest validation, adoption preview/apply, CLI command registration, MCP transport, generated CLI docs, and focused regressions

gate_state.user_authorization: present for the Grafana configuration apply; no additional permission requested
gate_state.verification: 60 service-runtime tests passed with 1 skipped; 44 focused command-tree and MCP tests passed; Ruff and generated CLI documentation audit passed, as reported by the implementer

tools_used: read-only git diff and status inspection

findings_summary.finding: The first revision allowed a different image to be adopted in a later confirmed invocation than the image observed during preview.
findings_summary.resolution: External adoption now requires an explicit immutable expected_image_id, compares it to Docker inspect, persists equal image_id and expected_image_id, rechecks the image on ordinary inspection, and exposes the exact image and Compose identity in the preview receipt.

findings_summary.finding: The first revision did not bind mount write mode and accepted an ambiguous any-match mount.
findings_summary.resolution: The adapter now requires exactly one mount at the declared target, exact bind source, bind type, and RW=false; project, service, container name, and image remain exact checks.

findings_summary.classification: confirmed coverage gap, closed for the bounded path
findings_summary.finding: The first revision lacked transport and key drift regressions.
findings_summary.resolution: Tests now cover image, Compose label, writable mount, duplicate-target drift, and identical CLI/MCP forwarding. Manifest validation also rejects Compose and expected-image fields outside external Docker adoption.

accepted_properties: External adoption is opt-in; existing Anvil-labelled discovery is unchanged.
Docker context is local-only, subprocess arguments are structured, and execution time and output are bounded.
The manifest update remains compare-and-swap and the container is re-inspected immediately before persistence.
The adapter reads no mounted configuration content and returns no secrets.
residual_risk: The adapter proves lifecycle identity and a read-only bind relationship; it does not validate or apply the mounted configuration contents.

A container can change after the final inspection and manifest save, but the pinned image, labels, name, and mount make later status or lifecycle operations fail closed rather than act on a replacement.

breakage_probes.axis: fail-closed behavior when state or tools are unreadable
breakage_probes.concrete_input_or_state: Docker context or inspect is unavailable, malformed, oversized, or returns zero or multiple rows.
breakage_probes.wrong_result: An unverified external service is persisted.
breakage_probes.classification: refuted by bounded Docker helpers and single-inspection validation

breakage_probes.concrete_input_or_state: Option-like names, invalid image IDs, control characters or CRLF in paths, relative paths, stray external fields, writable binds, or duplicate target mounts.
breakage_probes.wrong_result: Argument injection or an ambiguous identity is persisted.
breakage_probes.classification: refuted by structured argv, manifest validation, exact image checks, and exact read-only mount checks

breakage_probes.concrete_input_or_state: Docker inspect blocks or emits excessive output.
breakage_probes.wrong_result: Adoption blocks or allocates without a bound.
breakage_probes.classification: refuted by the 15-second adapter timeout, enclosing operation deadline, and 1 MiB output limit

breakage_probes.axis: state drift across CLI, MCP, process, manifest, and Compose seams
breakage_probes.concrete_input_or_state: Change the image, Compose owner, name, or configuration mount between review and apply, or during apply.
breakage_probes.wrong_result: The confirmed operation records a different identity than the reviewed declaration.
breakage_probes.classification: refuted by mandatory expected_image_id, identical CLI/MCP bindings, pre-save reinspection, and manifest compare-and-swap

advisory_priors: This acceptance covers external Compose adoption only. Configuration-content review and Grafana apply evidence remain separate gates.
workflow_packet_validate and operation_contracts were unavailable in this reviewer environment.

recommendation.reason: The revised adapter binds the reviewed immutable image, exact Compose owner, exact read-only configuration bind, local Docker context, preview disclosure, and pre-save reinspection. The reported focused gates pass.
recommendation.live_apply: may proceed through the existing managed preview and confirmed apply under the user authorization already recorded

human_gate_note: The user already authorized the Grafana configuration apply; this review adds no new permission requirement.
